data.exact_reserve_text:
Favourable movements of GBP 16.0 million, (2014: GBP 18.6 million), in the past year's provision for claims outstanding, net of expected reinsurance recoveries, are included in claims incurred, net of reinsurance. These arose in respect of the following classes of business:

Change in prior year provisions (8,228) (7,808) (16,036)

prior_year_events.impact_description: Large increase in ultimate claims for the 2011 underwriting year due to the Reinsurance to Close (RITC) transfers from syndicates 1965 and 2243.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2015 gross claims outstanding (opening reserves) were GBP 308.138m. During 2015 the syndicate recorded a gross prior-year release of GBP 8.228m (approximately 2.7% of opening reserves), driven by favourable claims development across prior underwriting years. The net favourable movement (after reinsurance) was GBP 16.036m. The 2015 position was also materially affected by Reinsurance to Close (RITC) receipts of GBP 85.227m relating to other syndicates, which increased gross reserves but are disclosed separately in the technical provisions reconciliation.
raw_causal_phrases: Favourable movements of GBP 16.0 million, (2014: GBP 18.6 million), in the past year's provision for claims outstanding, net of expected reinsurance recoveries, are included in claims incurred, net of reinsurance.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves and prior year movement taken from the Technical Provisions reconciliation (gross columns) which are presented in the GBP 000 columnar tables. Prior-year breakdown by class (note 7) is presented as net of reinsurance; gross PY movement is available in the technical provisions table. A material RITC (GBP 85.227k) was taken on in 2015 which distorts development for earlier underwriting years (notably 2011). Some small gross premium line items in the segmental table are negative or very small; these were transcribed as printed. Lob movements shown are net-of-reinsurance figures from note 7 (confidence reduced accordingly).
